【作者简介】

我出生在夏天，属于一个热情奔放的星座，但是朋友们却都不觉得我像是那个星座的人，

因为我既不热情、也不奔放，我比较内敛，不太会将情绪流露出来，也很不擅于表达自己。

有朋友说我习惯于把自己藏起来，不懂得外放，我也觉得是这样，最近正在努力尝试改变，

希望有一天，不会再有朋友怀疑我——

“你是狮子座的啊，看起来一点都不像。”

【序言 月光下的奇迹】

不知道大家有没有看过《奇迹》这部韩剧，里面的异卵双胞胎姊妹互换了身体，而让她们的长才都有了发挥的空间，对她们的人生都产生了改变，这次，主题书“月亮升起时”也是这样带点魔幻的故事，在月亮的魔力之下，主题书三本故事中的女主角都跟人交换了身体，进而得到一展长才的机会，同时圆满自己的姻缘。

在香弥的《村花有财气》中，女主角因为撞到脑袋，魂魄离体，附到了一个遭遇船难的皇商庶女身上，不只遇上了同样落难的男主角，展现野外求生的本领，让男主角对她刮目相看，更展现出赚钱的天赋，在皇商家获得一席之地，只是皇商庶女无意中目击了家里的一桩大秘密，为她招来了杀身之祸……

这下她死了，回到自己的身体里，该怎么跟男主角相认哩？

而裘梦的《密探有点忙》里，身为密探的女主角跟娇弱的相爷千金交换了身躯，只是两人都各有心上人，这一换身体可全都乱了套，而且还有来自皇亲国戚的威胁，意图把变成相爷千金的女主角抓走，更伪造通敌文书栽赃相爷，如果女主角没有当密探的经验，就要陷入大危机……

春野樱在《镇店女朝奉》中，则是安排女主角从富家千金变成了家道中落古董店的千金，振兴家业，避免自己被嫁给七老八十的老头当小妾换钱是她的第一要务，幸好她有着监定古董的好眼光，获得赏识，成为女朝奉，而东家不只长得俊俏、为人仗义，让女主角深深喜欢上他，但问题来了，东家有婚约，而那个婚约对象还是……身为富家千金的她自己！

三位女主角究竟要怎么做才能顺利圆满自己的爱情？而在换了身躯的期间，男女主角又会擦出什么火花？大家千万别错过“月亮升起时”主题书～

第1章(1)

“陈爷，四周潮气越来越重，似乎即将有一场大雨，咱们的船可要暂时靠岸停泊？”客船上一名经验老道的老船工特来请示东家。

坐在舱房里一名蓄着胡须，身量微胖的中年男子摇头道：“不成，今天得在亥时前赶到华阳码头去，明儿个一早，有批货得交给人家，不能误了时辰。老蔡，你让咱们弟兄辛苦些，加把劲赶路，工资我加发一倍。”这艘船虽是客船，但载客的同时也会顺道替人运送货物。

老船工犹豫了下，终究没再说什么的应了声，离开东家的舱房，去向兄弟们转告东家意思，客船上六面风帆全都张开，在淮江上乘风航行。

盛夏时分，船舱里十分燠热，待红日隐没于西山后，不少人纷纷跑到甲板上乘凉，有一人抬头望见天边初升的月轮，咦了声。

“今儿个是满月啊。”

“今天十六了。”有人回了声。

“是我眼花还是怎么了，我怎么瞧着那月亮似乎是红色的？”有人讶异的出声。

另一人抬目看去，附和道：“你说的没错，这月亮似乎泛着红色。”

“据说出现红月可是不祥之兆。”有人惊慌道，他话才说完，忽然刮起大风，吹得甲板上众人踉跄着有些站不稳身子，纷纷避进船舱里。

不久，那轮猩红色的圆月被飘来的一片铅灰色乌云掩住。

稍顷，黑云中亮起一道道宛如蛟龙的闪电，旋即雷声大作，一道落雷刚好砸落，喀嚓一声，一枝桅杆被劈断，上头的风帆顷刻间烧起来，下一瞬，天上落下的倾盆大雨，正好浇熄起那熊熊火焰。

这滂沱大雨一下便是一个多时辰，客船在雷暴雨中艰难的缓慢前行，船身在高涨的风浪里被颠得左摇右摆，晃得客船上的人心惊胆颤，唯恐船只会被怒涛掀翻。

因着这场突如其来的雷暴雨，眼看已无法在亥时赶到下一个渡头，为顾及安全，船东命船工们先将这艘客船驶向附近的岸边下锚，打算暂时避一避这一场遽来的豪雨。

风急浪高，船工们拼命摇着桨，却抵挡不了湍急的江水和倾盆的暴雨，一时间，客船只能在怒涛里随波起伏，无法航向岸边停泊。

此时船上一间舱房里，有个约莫十六、七岁的姑娘躺在狭窄的木榻上，甫睁开紧闭的双眼，就因腹部袭来的剧痛蜷缩起身子。

而舱房外，一名婆子和一名丫头被颠得站不稳，急忙抱着一旁的柱子，才勉强稳住身子，没被颠得摔跤。

那名丫头整个人贴在柱子上，两只手牢牢抱着柱子，脸色有些发白的道：“这外头雨下这么大，咱们的船不会有事吧？”她走出舱房，本是想去找人打探消息，看看眼下是个什么光景，这客船究竟能不能撑过这场暴风雨，可刚离开舱房，就被颠得站都站不稳，无法再往前走。

“咱们坐的这艘客船这么大，想来不会有事，我只担心四姑娘，万一出了什么事，那可如何是好。”婆子面露愁容的瞥了眼身后的舱房，她原是想找人弄些药来给突然昏厥不醒的主子服用，才跟着一起出来。

因没再进船舱，所以她丝毫不知，就在她和那丫头走出船舱不久，她口中的四姑娘已然醒来，这会儿正被剧痛折腾得唇瓣都咬破，掌心也被掐出血来。

“赵婆子，你还有心情担心四姑娘，咱们这船颠得越来越厉害，我只怕万一撑不住，咱们可都要没命。”她不会凫水啊。这么一想，她心头越发惊怕起来，没好脸色的朝赵婆子啐骂道，“我先前就说别坐船，你非要坐船不可，这要是出事，全怪你。”

见她竟责怪起自己来，赵婆子哪忍得了，反驳道：“你这丫头恁地不讲道理，坐船虽是老婆子我提议的，可你当时也没反对，这会儿倒怪起我来。”

“分明是你怂恿四姑娘坐船，我一个丫头哪能反对。”她说话时，一波巨浪打来，船身被撞得猛然一晃，原本已朝岸边驶去的船头瞬间被打歪，船底撞上一块礁石，瞬间，滔滔江水从撞破的船底凶猛的灌入。

船身颠簸摇晃得越发剧烈，整个客船上的人几乎无人能再站稳，不少人都像木桶般，随着倾斜的船身滚来滚去，那丫头和赵婆子滚到另一头去，船上四处传来惊叫声和嘶喊声。

“船要翻了！”

“救命啊—”

“我不会凫水，谁快来救本少爷，本少爷给他一百两银子……”

那丫头也惊恐的尖叫着，伸长手拼命想抓住什么来稳住身子，她好不容易办妥了那人的吩咐，只要回到府里，就能得到两百两重赏，足够她帮爹娘和弟弟在城里买一栋宅子，还能剩下一些银子给弟弟娶媳妇，她不能就这样死在这里……

而此刻躺在舱房木榻上饱受剧痛折磨的寒招财也摔下木榻，撞上了一旁的舱壁，疼痛稍缓，她睁开双眼，听见外头四处传来的呼救声、惊慌失措的尖叫声，她神色茫然，一时无法厘清究竟发生什么事。

[About the author]

I was born in summer and belong to a passionate zodiac sign, but my friends don’t think I belong to that zodiac sign.

Because I am neither passionate nor unrestrained. I am relatively reserved, not very able to express my emotions, and am not very good at expressing myself.

Some friends said that I am used to hiding myself and don’t know how to express myself. I also think that is the case. I am trying to change it recently.

I hope one day no more friends will doubt me——

"You are a Leo, you look nothing like you."

【Preface Miracle under the Moonlight】

I don’t know if you have watched the Korean drama "Miracle". In it, the fraternal twin sisters exchanged bodies, which gave them room to display their talents and changed their lives. This time, the theme book "When the Moon Rises" is also a magical story. Under the magic of the moon, the heroines in the three stories in the theme book all exchanged bodies with others, and then got the opportunity to show off their talents and at the same time consummate their marriages.

In Xiangya's "Village Flower", the heroine hit her head and her soul left her body and possessed the body of a concubine of an imperial merchant who was in a shipwreck. Not only did she meet the male protagonist who was also in trouble, she showed her ability to survive in the wild, which impressed the male protagonist. She also showed her talent for making money and gained a place in the imperial merchants. However, the concubine of an imperial merchant accidentally witnessed a big secret in the family, which led to her death...

Now that she is dead and back in her own body, how can she recognize the hero?

In Qiu Meng's "The Secret Agent is a Little Busy", the heroine who is a secret agent exchanges bodies with the delicate daughter of the prime minister, but both of them have their own sweethearts. This body change is all messed up, and there are also threats from the emperor's relatives, who intend to kidnap the heroine who has become the daughter of the prime minister, and even forge documents of collaboration with the enemy to frame the prime minister. If the heroine does not have the experience of being a spy, she will be in a big crisis...

Haruno Sakura arranged for the heroine to change from the daughter of a wealthy family to the daughter of a middle-aged antique shop in "The Shopkeeper". Her first priority was to revitalize the family business and avoid being married to an old man as a concubine in exchange for money. Fortunately, she has a supervisorThe good taste of antiques was appreciated and he became a female court servant. His boss was not only handsome and righteous, but also made the heroine fall in love with him. But the problem came. His boss had a marriage contract, and the marriage partner was... herself, the daughter of a wealthy family!

What should the three heroines do to successfully consummate their love?And during the period of changing bodies, what kind of sparks will the male and female protagonists create?Don’t miss the “When the Moon Rises” themed book~

Chapter 1(1)

"Mr. Chen, the humidity around us is getting heavier and heavier. It seems that there is going to be a heavy rain. Can our ship temporarily dock?" An experienced boatman on the passenger ship came to ask for instructions from the owner.

A middle-aged man with a beard and a slight build sitting in the cabin shook his head and said: "No, we have to rush to Huayang Pier before Hai Shi today. A batch of goods must be delivered to someone early tomorrow morning, so we can't miss the time. Lao Cai, please let our brothers work harder and drive harder. I will double the salary." Although this ship is a passenger ship, it will also transport goods for others while carrying passengers.

The old boatman hesitated for a moment, and finally agreed without saying anything. He left his master's cabin and went to tell his brothers what his master wanted. All six sails on the passenger ship were spread out and sailed on the Huai River.

In midsummer, it was very hot inside the cabin. When the red sun disappeared behind the western mountains, many people ran to the deck to enjoy the cool air. One person looked up and saw the rising moon in the sky and made a sound.

"It's a full moon today."

"I'm sixteen today." someone replied.

"Is it my eyesight or something? Why does the moon seem to be red when I look at it?" Someone said in surprise.

Another person looked up and echoed: "You are right, the moon seems to be glowing red."

"It is said that the appearance of a red moon is an ominous sign." Someone panicked. Just as he finished speaking, a strong wind suddenly blew up, causing everyone on the deck to stumble and become somewhat unsteady, and they hid in the cabin one after another.

Soon, the scarlet full moon was covered by a leaden gray cloud.

After a while, streaks of lightning like dragons lit up in the black clouds, and then there was a loud thunder, and a thunderbolt hit. With a click, a mast was broken, and the sail above burned instantly. The next moment, the heavy rain fell from the sky, extinguishing the blazing flames.

The torrential rain lasted for more than an hour. The passenger ship moved forward slowly and with difficulty in the thunderstorm. The ship's hull was shaken left and right in the high wind and waves. The shaking made the people on the passenger ship tremble with fear, fearing that the ship would be capsized by the roaring waves.

Due to this sudden thunderstorm, it seemed that it was impossible to reach the next ferry at Haishi. For safety reasons, the shipowner ordered the boatmen to anchor the passenger ship to a nearby shore, intending to temporarily avoid the sudden heavy rain.

The wind was strong and the waves were high, and the boatmen were swinging their oars desperately, but they could not withstand the turbulent river water and the pouring rain. For a while, the passenger ship was able to heave with the waves in the roaring waves and was unable to sail to the shore.

At this time, in a cabin on the ship, there was a girl about sixteen or seventeen years old lying on a narrow wooden couch. As soon as she opened her closed eyes, she curled up due to the severe pain in her abdomen.

Outside the cabin, a woman and a girl were knocked unsteady. They hurriedly hugged the pillar beside them and managed to steady themselves without being knocked down.

The girl was leaning against the pillar, holding the pillar firmly with both hands, and said with a pale face: "It's raining so hard outside, will our ship be okay?" She walked out of the cabin, originally wanting to find someone to find out what the situation was like, and whether the passenger ship could survive the storm, but as soon as she left the cabin, she was shaken so hard that she couldn't stand still and couldn't go any further.

"The passenger ship we are traveling on is so big, I don't think anything will happen. I'm just worried about the fourth girl. What should I do if something happens?" The mother-in-law glanced at the cabin behind her with a sad face. She originally wanted to find someone to get some medicine for her master who suddenly fainted, so she came out with her.

Since she did not enter the cabin again, she had no idea that shortly after she and the girl walked out of the cabin, the fourth girl she was talking about had woken up. She was suffering from severe pain that caused her lips to be bitten and her palms to bleed.

"Mrs. Zhao, are you still in the mood to worry about the fourth girl? Our boat is getting more and more bumpy. I'm afraid that if we can't hold on, we will all die." She doesn't know how to swim.Thinking of this, she became more and more frightened and cursed at Mrs. Zhao with a shameless face, "I told you not to take the boat before. You have to take the boat. If something happens, it will be all your fault."

Seeing that she was actually blaming herself, Mrs. Zhao couldn't bear it anymore and retorted: "You girl is so unreasonable. Although it was my suggestion to take the boat, you didn't object at the time. Now you are blaming me."

"It's obvious that you encouraged the fourth girl to take the boat. How can I, a girl, object?" As she was speaking, a huge wave hit, and the boat was shaken suddenly. The bow of the boat, which had been heading towards the shore, was instantly deflected, and the bottom of the boat hit a rock. In an instant, the torrent of river water poured in ferociously from the bottom of the broken boat.

The hull bumped and rocked more and more violently, and almost no one on the entire passenger ship could stand still. Many people were like barrels, rolling around with the tilting hull. The girl and Mrs. Zhao rolled to the other end, and screams and shouts were heard from all over the ship.

"The boat is going to capsize!"

"Help-"

"I don't know how to drink water. Someone come and save this young master. I will give him one hundred taels of silver..."

The girl also screamed in horror, stretching out her hands desperately trying to grab something to stabilize her body. She finally fulfilled the man's instructions. As long as she returned to the house, she would get a reward of two hundred taels, which was enough for her to help her parents and brother buy a house in the city, and there was still some money left for her brother to find a wife. She couldn't die here like this...

At this moment, Han Zhaocai, who was lying on the wooden couch in the cabin and suffering from severe pain, also fell off the wooden couch and hit the bulkhead on the side. The pain subsided slightly. She opened her eyes and heard calls for help and panicked screams coming from everywhere outside. She looked confused and couldn't figure out what happened for a moment.
